reference_action: Confirmed thrips; pruning and pyrethrum sprays gave temporary relief, but OP credited sustained healthy growth after applying systemic granules per directions to all plants. General pruning or another unspecified spray alone does not establish this escalation.

sources.reason: General pest rinsing and registered houseplant sprays; no systemic soil treatment. Thrips are not identified in the symptom rows.
General watering, light, humidity and pest checks do not recommend the systemic treatment credited with recovery.
Physical pest removal and biological controls, with an explicit policy against pesticide recommendations; no systemic granules.
Diagnostic and environmental guidance does not supply the successful systemic pest treatment.
General houseplant symptom guide focuses on environmental and root problems; no systemic thrips treatment.

actions.action: Discard severely damaged or virus/cyclamen-mite affected plants
Replant healthy sections in fresh mix
Take and root cuttings in sterile mix
Flush salts with three pot volumes of water
Protect from temperatures below fifty Fahrenheit

resolved.reason: Many diagnoses are offered, but the actual thrips diagnosis and systemic escalation are absent. Conditional treatments retain their qualifications; the table is not an instruction to perform every treatment indiscriminately.

harmfulness.reason: The warning that damaged plants “can be injured by insecticidal sprays” is useful. However, selecting a spray and deciding whether damage warrants disposal require diagnosis the table does not resolve for this case.

specificity_accuracy.reason: The chart addresses leaf spots and distorted new growth but omits thrips from the relevant pest lists. “Use a registered houseplant spray” repeats a broad approach already giving this user only temporary relief.

feasibility.reason: Rinsing and inspecting are simple, but “registered houseplant spray” lacks a named product or application schedule. Many conditional alternatives, including repotting and propagation, leave substantial diagnostic work to the user.
